paragraphs.text: This prayer as is thought, was made when some of the people were carried away captive, others such as the poorest remained, and some went into Egypt and other places for comfort, though it seems that the prophet foreseeing their miseries to come, thus prayed.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Meaning their extreme servitude and bondage.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: We are joined in league and amity with them, or have submitted ourselves to them.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: As our fathers have been punished for their sins: so we that are guilty of the same sins are punished.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Because of the enemy that came from the wilderness and would not suffer us to go and seek our necessary food.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, by the enemies hand.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Their slavery was so great, that they were not able to abide it.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: There were no more laws nor form of commonwealth.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: And therefore your covenant and mercies can never fail.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: By which is declared that it is not in man's power to turn to God, but is only his work to convert us, and thus God works in us before we can turn to him, Jer 31:18.
paragraphs.label: l
